decisive_test: At finite cutoff, use one common relative operator K_X and compare (i) its P1 and P2 endpoint currents, (ii) its det3 connected section, and (iii) the forcing-history pair's conservative Green boundary. Equality must hold coefficientwise before determinant multiplication and survive cutoff completion.
conclusion: The recurrent four-level pattern is present. The order-three determinant plus Mellin-Poisson section supplies level four, and the pair-to-Euler bridge supplies an observable wrap toward level one. What is missing is that wrap's kernel-exact conservative enhancement. This is exactly why scalar Xi provenance, relative coherence, and positive noncollapse can all coexist without yet proving confinement.
